name: KEPCO Naju Integrated ICT Center, Phase 1
notes: Uptime Institute lists KEPCO's Naju Integrated ICT Center, Phase 1 in Naju-si, Jeollanam-do with Tier III design and constructed-facility certifications. Public capacity not found.

name: NHN Enterprise Suncheon Public Cloud Data Center
developer: NHN Enterprise / NHN Cloud with Jeollanam-do and Suncheon City
notes: 2021 MOU covered a KRW 300 billion, 20-year investment for a public cloud data center and smart IT valley in Suncheon. Yonhap reported in 2024 that construction had been delayed by site-selection/security-guideline issues, so status is kept planned.

name: SolaSeaDo RE100 Data Center Campus
developer: Bosung Group / The Green Korea (EIP-Diode Ventures)
notes: Project described as five 40MW renewable-powered data centers in SolaSeaDo from 2023-2030. SolaSeaDo is the Yeongam-Haenam tourism/leisure enterprise city; specific data-center parcels are often described around Haenam, so division assignment to Yeongam-gun reflects the cross-county enterprise city footprint.

name: KT Cheongju IDC
notes: Colocation directory sources list KT Cheongju IDC in Cheongju-si; Datacenters.com reports access to 20MW of power. Older Korean press confirms Cheongju IDC operations, but no current official capacity page found.

name: Daecheong Dam Hydrothermal Specialized Data Center Cluster
notes: Chungcheongbuk-do, Cheongju and K-water launched planning for a Daecheong Dam hydrothermal-energy specialized district intended to support AI/data-center cooling plus smart farms and industrial facilities. Later local reporting references a KRW 352.5 billion investment-leading district selection; specific IT load not found.

name: POSCO ICT Chungju Cloud Data Center
notes: POSCO ICT announced launch of its Chungju cloud data center on 2012-10-18. Site area is 12,758 sq m and gross floor area is 7,742 sq m across three basement levels; public MW capacity not found.

name: KATI Chungju Data Center
developer: Powerlink Co., Ltd.; LG CNS; POSCO E&C; POSCO ICT
notes: Chungcheongbuk-do and Chungju signed an investment agreement for Powerlink's KATI Chungju Data Center in Dongchungju Industrial Complex. Reported receiving capacity is 80MW, IT load 48MW, on a 23,345 sq m site with 42,496 sq m total floor area.

name: SK Group Chungju AI Data Center Candidate Site
notes: MK reported SK Group officials inspected Chungju Dream Park Industrial Complex as one candidate for a Chungcheong-area 1GW AI data center. Still under internal review across multiple candidate sites, so status is unknown and capacity reflects the regional target rather than a committed Chungju allocation.
